Stereophonic is a theatrical experience unlike any other, a three-hour journey that immerses you so completely in the world of a 1970s recording studio that you forget you're watching a play.
‘Stereophonic’ is a unique and singular exploration of the passion and torment that comes with making art that passes the test of time, and I have little doubt that this play will, too.
In terms of fresh ideas about the creative process, the play doesn’t deliver an LP’s worth of insights.
But why we have to be locked in here for over three hours, only Adjmi knows.

cn.t: Critics praise the immersive 1970s studio setting and innovative blend of music and drama, though some find the three-hour runtime excessive and appeal limited to classic rock fans.

vr.q: I love this play. I cannot recommend it enough.
